items.title: Evaluating Context Compaction on the Questions That Come Later
items.title_zh: 评估上下文压缩对后续问题的表现
items.summary: The study evaluates context compaction against later questions using four corpora that annotate evidence for several questions per text and recorded agent trajectories, comparing every method with random deletion at the same budget. Selecting sentences for the current question raised MultiRC accuracy by 11.4 points at 25% of tokens but did not detectably help later questions, while question-ignoring LLMLingua-2 beat random sentence deletion by 12.5 points on later MultiRC questions.

items.title: EGI-BENCH: An Enterprise General Intelligence Benchmark Suite
items.title_zh: EGI-BENCH：企业通用智能基准套件
items.summary: EGI-BENCH consolidates eight enterprise agent benchmarks behind one command-line interface with two runtime-budgeted modes and defines a six-dimensional EGI Score populated by routed sub-metrics rather than benchmark averages. Across fourteen frontier and cost-efficient models, top-line EGI ranged from 39.6 for GPT-4o mini to 65.6 for gpt-5.5, with no single model leading every capability axis.

items.title: DeepSeek releases V4.1 Flash-1017 with stronger coding and agent capabilities
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4.1 Flash-1017，强化编程与智能体能力
items.summary: DeepSeek released V4.1 Flash-1017 on October 17, updating its Flash model with improvements in reasoning, coding, agent tasks and visual understanding.

items.title: More Memory, Worse Agents: Error Reproduction and Anti-Persistence in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 记忆越多，智能体越差：LLM 智能体的错误复现与反持久化
items.summary: The paper describes error reproduction, in which faulty stored abstractions propagate through retrieval, execution and re-abstraction and extend the life of errors in LLM agents. Its Anti-Persistence design retains trajectories but rebuilds guidance on demand and discards it after execution, reporting higher held-out success and the lowest average LLM-call cost among the evaluated memory designs.

items.title: SHAM-Bench: A Span-level Hallucination Benchmark Across Multiple Tasks
items.title_zh: SHAM-Bench：跨多任务的 span 级幻觉基准
items.summary: SHAM-Bench is a unified benchmark for span-level hallucination detection across six NLG tasks, built from 6,461 human-annotated examples under a common schema and evaluation protocol. The authors report that fine-tuned detectors often degrade under distribution shift, while prompt-based methods with reasoning are more robust.

items.title: Diagnostic Analysis for Large Language Model Reasoning
items.title_zh: 大语言模型推理的诊断性分析
items.summary: The paper proposes a two-stage diagnostic evaluation of reasoning structures in open-ended multi-hop QA, first testing the capabilities needed to build reasoning graphs and then using uncertainty estimation as a downstream test. Graph reliability varied with topology, prompt design and model family; generated-edge graphs were sensitive to upstream errors, and gold graphs provided little benefit as prompt context but improved confidence-based separation and node-level diagnostics.

items.title: On the Fragility of Tasks under Composition: Implicit Budgeting in Language Models
items.title_zh: 任务组合下的脆弱性：语言模型中的隐式预算
items.summary: The paper finds that language models make substantially more errors when tasks are composed, even when each constituent task is solved reliably in isolation, and that this is not fully explained by independent error accumulation. Evidence across open-weight models and Claude Opus 5 points to an implicit thinking budget: composed prompts receive fewer tokens per task, and grouping tasks by fragility cut token usage by 43% while preserving accuracy.

items.title: Exposing Vulnerability Monoculture Through Systemic Adversarial Robustness
items.title_zh: 以系统性对抗鲁棒性揭示漏洞单一化
items.summary: The paper introduces Systemic Adversarial Robustness (SAR), a measure of shared vulnerability in a model pool based on the attack diversity needed to compromise it, formulated as a partial set-cover problem with approximation guarantees. Model pools distilled from DeepSeek-R1 and Claude Opus 4.6 showed lower estimated systemic robustness than their parent pools, indicating a potential systemic cost of frontier-model distillation.

items.title: ProMemAgent: Long-Horizon Proactive Assistance with Context-Aware Prospective Memory from Sensory Perceptions
items.title_zh: ProMemAgent：基于感官感知的上下文感知前瞻记忆长程主动助手
items.summary: ProMemAgent organizes past sensory perceptions such as egocentric video and audio into context-aware memory and generates prospective cues that support delayed intentions over long horizons. The authors introduce CPMBench, a 1,000-instance benchmark across eight everyday categories, on which the agent outperforms all baselines.

items.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
items.title_zh: 提升低资源编程语言的编码能力
items.summary: OpenAI describes work to improve ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, supported by new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite and COBOL migration.
